messages:
Jasmin Lee: Quick sync — OrbitLabs interview complete. Need final hero quote, legal sign-off on numbers, and the webinar promotional blurb. Target: publish case study next Fri, webinar week after. :spiral_calendar:
Roberto Diaz: Pulled these candidate quotes from the transcript:

1) "Redwood reduced our inference spend by 41%, letting us ship model updates weekly."
2) "Stable tail latency is the reason our engagement improved."
3) "Their rollout tooling caught a bad model before it hit prod."

Tom Baker: Orbit prefers quote #1 but wants the wording to be "inference spend" not just "costs". They also have a slide showing 41% in the ROI appendix.
Priya Menon: Legal note: percent claims need either an attestation or the slide uploaded. If we publish the 41% we should add "per OrbitLabs" attribution. Also confirm logo usage in the release.
Jasmin Lee: I'll prepare two variants of the hero: one with the explicit 41% + attribution, and a softened one saying "over 40%" for social.
Roberto Diaz: Orbit sent the signed attestation and the ROI appendix. Forwarding now.
Legal Bot: Attestation received. Quick redline: suggest changing "reduced our inference spend by 41%" to "reduced inference spend by 41%, per OrbitLabs" and include a link to the ROI appendix in the case study.
Priya Menon: Redline done and sent to Orbit for final sign-off on logo treatment. If they approve by EOD, marketing can push to staging tomorrow.
Tom Baker: I'm drafting the webinar blurb: 30-45 minute panel with OrbitLabs engineering + Redwood product. Will call out the 41% number on the landing page (with attribution). Social will use the softened "over 40%" line.
Jasmin Lee: Design ask: need a hero image and a 1-slide SDR summary. Assets team, can you deliver by noon tomorrow? :pray:
Legal Bot: Confirmed sign-off received for logo and quotes. Release signed at 11:03.
Roberto Diaz: Assets approved on customer side. Dropping final quote timestamp and headshot in #marketing-assets.
Jasmin Lee: Great — final checklist: (1) publish case study to staging, (2) upload webinar landing with panel details, (3) queue social posts (soft copy), (4) send one-pager to SDRs. Targeting staging push tomorrow AM.
Tom Baker: I'll set the webinar registration and tag the SDR queue for inbound routing.
Jasmin Lee: Closing this thread unless anything blocks. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
